title: FFmpeg GIF Stats-Mode Comparison — Experiment Package
purpose: Isolated experiment to measure whether palette stats_mode (full vs diff vs single) changes output file size and colour accuracy more than dither choice does, using the same clip and dither treatment (sierra2_4a default) throughout. Companion to the dither-isolation package (artifact f20e0b08). Fills the gap noted in rubric.md: "Repeat with stats_mode=diff if background is mostly static."
